1944, December
Page 57 1944 Dec. 27 Vanevelt, Dan - 78 - heart ... now in oxigen-tent
Thomas Horal - 18 - heart ...
Patricia Grube - 20 - T.B. - 2nd operation yesterday ... not well
Dec. 29
Pvt. Robert Jerors - 21 - Reports in action - Missing ....
29 Dr. Elmer W.O'Berski - 28 - mental break - in Ford's .... Enrolled perpetually -- promises PP. Souls (Wife) fifty Enrollments
Donald Smith - 22 - Flyer lost missing since Aug. 7th
Baby James Carney - 10 mo. - peculiarly weak - enrolled in Ser. Masses ... seems improving at once.
31 Rob. Bauer - 37 - lost sight in one eye completely two weeks ago. Dr's have hardly any hope saving sight at all - both eyes cause indiscribable pain - enrolls To-day.
